correctness.rationale: For each m=2..6 the orbit-barycenter construction exactly triangulates the geometric half-turn fixed space. Inspected exact polygon edge-orbit generation, proper-crossing and union-find forest tests and lexicographically deterministic discrete Morse matching. An independent bitmask implementation enumerated all faces and reversed matched Hasse edges for all five cases; it reproduced f-vectors (4,4), (9,24,21), (16,78,160,120), (25,190,660,1100,715), (36,390,2000,5445,7644,4368), pair counts 3,24,175,1290,9679 and critical top cells 1,5,23,109,524, and certified acyclic directed Hasse graph. Forman then yields wedge of b_m spheres in dimension m-1, since there is a single zero-cell and no intermediate cells.
